title: Hash Brown Tempura
description: A crispy and savory Japanese-inspired dish made with hash browns and a light tempura batter.
instructions: Cut hash browns into 1/2-inch cubes and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Gradually add soda water, stirring with a fork until the batter is smooth.
Heat 2 inches of jazzy oil in a large saucepan to 350°F.
Dredge hash browns in flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Dip floured hash browns in tempura batter, making sure they are fully coated.
Carefully place battered hash browns in hot oil, frying in batches until golden brown.
Drain fried hash browns on paper towels and sprinkle with american vinegar.
